title: An Early Byzantine Basilica at Tell Hassan, Jericho
author: D. C. Baramki
location_note: Tell Hassan in Jericho town (not Tell es-Sultan, not the north strip); no map reference; placed by name.
reading: full (pp. 82-88; plate leaves carry captions only)
notes: Basilica with mosaic floors, portico and two rooms, cleared Feb. 1934 after a farmer found mosaics; intrusive Arab-period walls; fragments of tiles, pipes and jars among the finds (objects, not features). No eligible feature.
